label: miso 40 band deleak
definition: (PROBE) Cross-ISO band de-leakage (audit C-11/C-13, rule #24): MISO's inherited ERCOT gas bands (CC_CHP, CT_CHP, ST_GAS, and the CT_PEAKER committed 1.55 / econ 1.27/1.98 'generic shape') are neutralized to 1.0; MISO-grounded CC_REGULAR (committed 1.20 part-load premium, flat 0.95/1.08 baseload econ), the MISO offer-cap CT peak 4.0, and the physical F-class CC duct-burner peak 2.25 are kept; *_INTERMEDIATE (measured-shape) and coal untouched. EFFECT vs keeper miso-39 (not re-tuned, rule #1): dropping the ERCOT 1.55 CT start-hurdle to 1.0 lets peakers run, so the CT_PEAKER under-run SHRINKS -20.5->-12.0 TWh (2023) / -18.2->-9.2 (2024); the cheaper neutral bids lower C3a mean LMP to -9.8/-15.7/-19.6% (was -8.5/-13.6/-16.9%). PRE-EXISTING MISO root causes unchanged by this scrub: the CC_REGULAR +44 TWh over-run (measured-flat econ body) and the 0-hour scarcity tail (missing RDC/ELMP co-opt) — both open items, not band-addressable.
